learnings: Parser + indexer live in packages/sql. Exported: parseDocument(pathname, bytes, stat?) and metadataDocument(pathname, stat?, kind?) → ParsedDocument {path,name,dir,ext,kind,title,titleFold,content,frontmatter,size,mtime,ctime,hash,blocks[],tags[],refs[]}; indexDocument(index, doc), writeDocument(tx, doc), removeDocument(index, path), resolveRefTargets, refCandidates; createIndexer(index, vfs, {logger, exclude?, maxFileSize?, batchSize?}) → Indexer {status, running, subscribe, scan, reindex, indexPath, removePath, cancel}; isIndexablePath/matchesGlob; detectDocumentKind/foldText/documentPath/blockId. No column was missing — SQL_SCHEMA_VERSION stays 1. SearchExtension now carries `indexer`, `processed` and `reindex()`; SearchPlugin.start() fires the walk without awaiting it (FR-223) and stop() cancels then awaits `indexer.running` before closing the index. PGlite hands bigint columns back as strings — cast ::float8 when a number is wanted. An engine package must not import vue: the indexer publishes a status snapshot plus subscribe(), and the plugin mirrors it into refs. A forward ref (target indexed later in the same walk) keeps target_path = null until its source is reindexed — APP-01-04 must not assume backlinks are complete.
